dedupe_keys.name: icmm global mining dataset locations of mines smelters refineries and processing plants worldwide v1 5 july 2026

description: The Global Mining Dataset of the International Council on Mining and Metals (ICMM) aims to fill the gap in standardised industry-wide data on the location of mining and metals facilities. Version 1, released in September 2025 from five source inputs, held 15,188 mines and processing facilities producing 47 primary commodities, of which 8,508 could be made public. After validation using geospatial analysis, large language models and manual review, version 1.5 (July 2026) removed 3,193 facilities judged misclassified, such as closed or historic sites, duplicates and coordinates of deposits or exploration prospects, leaving 12,000 facilities, 7,104 of them public. Coverage: global mining and metals facilities. A further update adding 14 more sources is planned for late 2026. Format and access: an Excel file and a KMZ file for each version, with a methodology and summary report (v1.5) or insights report (v1), and a feedback form; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): ICMM terms: reproduction free of charge for non-commercial, informational purposes with the source acknowledged. Caveats: only part of the dataset is public (7,104 of 12,000 facilities in version 1.5), and why the rest is withheld was not read; facility attributes beyond location and commodity were not read. Simulation uses: a global map of mines and plants for hazard exposure, water stress and supply chain studies of mining and the infrastructure that serves it. Related records: the FINEPRINT open mining database (data-fineprint-open-database-global-coal-metal-mining) adds production data for fewer facilities.
